data.text:
random life reflection no one asked for but i will share anyway: tbh pre pandemic, my career choices and growth was limited because of where I lived (qc) and the traffic/travel time/energy/cost to makati or bgc. I literally only applied and worked in qc, the farthest was ortigas for a bit, and only because it was my dream job. 

i feel that i could’ve grown faster and further if I took jobs at big companies in makati/bgc earlier. the only reason why i accepted a bgc-based office was because it was 2021, wfh. maaga kami nag RTO in 2022 but traffic was manageable. kaya ko bgc to home in 45 mins dati basta 8:30pm ako umalis. where i work now is hybrid 3 days RTO but to be honest these past few months ive been feeling the difficulty talaga. it’s like okay i’ve made it to qc pero commonwealth is the other half of the battle.

soooooobrang scary to drive alone at night lately. and for some reason i’ve been feeling much more anxious driving in commonwealth at night these past few weeks. di ko alam, the vibes are just off.

it’s so exhausting, I spend so much time on the road no matter how long ako magpalipas. last tuesday i left bgc at 9, got home at 11. it’s crazy. i love my home, it was the first space that I really had full control over from the layout, colors, everything. i’m a qc/up girl, i also need my trees and mountains.

i acknowledge how privileged i am to have my own car, a house, a job. but im so exhausted too and every day that goes by I feel that I really can’t live like this. and when i think about it there’s nothing for me in qc anymore now that i’m at this stage of my career.

so ayun. i might move, but with that comes a whole new set of things to think about. and in the past what i’d say was: i refuse to uproot my life for a job. but lately ive been feeling that my job has been uprooting my life. 

at the end of the day: if we had an efficient public transport system, if our streets were walkable, if simply existing as a woman alone at night was safe, so many of us wouldn’t have to make these difficult choices and uproot our lives (or let our lives be uprooted) just to survive.

#BBFanFest #BlushBlossomProject #emibonnie #เอมี่บอนนี่ #BBPHCollab #PinoyBlushBlossom 

📊✨ EBPH #BBFanFest Transparency Report ✨📊
Total Funds Raised: ₱62,441.41
We extend our deepest gratitude to every Filipino ANY and international fan who supported this initiative — through donations, shares, kind messages, or silent encouragement from afar. This was a collective labor of love, powered by trust, generosity, and shared admiration for Emi and Bonnie. 🤍

Below is a full breakdown of our two-part project:

🎶 Part 1: BBFanFest Initiatives
📦 ₱40,941.41 onhand | 💸 ₱48,876.03 spent
📎 Full report: BBFanFest Transparency – Part 1

This phase focused on large-scale collaborative efforts during Thai GL Fan Fest, showcasing the love and support of Filipino fans on an international stage.

✅ PH ANYs Fanbook Project – filled with fan letters, art, and heartfelt messages. Currently in production and scheduled for pick-up and delivery soon.

✅ Custom Vinyl Albums for Emi & Bonnie – unique, handcrafted gifts proudly featured at their booth during Thai GL Fan Fest.

✅ 12 TukTuk Ads Around GMMTV (in collaboration with @JustForYou0412) – fully secured and set to launch on June 27, 2025, surrounding the GMMTV area in Bangkok.

📉 Overspent by ₱7,934.62 due to upgrades and logistics — responsibly covered by Part 2.

💝 Part 2: Pinoy Blush Blossom Project
📥 ₱21,500 raised | 💸 ₱20,681.60 used
📎 Full report: Pinoy Blush Blossom – Part 2

This phase centered on creating meaningful surprise gifts from Filipino fans to Emi and Bonnie — expressing pride, creativity, and warmth.

✅ Covered Part 1’s excess to complete all previously committed activities with no compromise in quality

✅ Delivered all three surprise gifts — now safely in Thailand, ready to be handed over to Emi and Bonnie:

🎁 Gift #1 (👠) – an elegant, personalized fashion item
🎁 Gift #2 (👜) – a thoughtful and stylish accessory
🎁 Gift #3 (🥨🛍️) – a curated bundle featuring snacks and locally inspired tokens

📍 Remaining balance: ₱818.40 – set aside for future EBPH initiatives

🌸 To All Who Made This Possible
This was not only a Filipino fan project — it was an international show of unity, generosity, and shared love.

To our fellow international ANYs, thank you so much for believing in us and supporting from wherever you are in the world. Your donations and encouragement helped make these gifts a reality, and your solidarity meant the world to our small team. 🌍💖

Whether you contributed ₱20 or $20, helped spread the word, or simply cheered from afar — you were part of this journey. This is more than a fandom. It’s a global family.

📌 Remaining funds will go toward future EmiBonnie projects under EBPH. Our commitment continues — full of heart, creativity, and purpose.

#BBFanFest #BlushBlossomProject #emibonnie #เอมี่บอนนี่ #BBPHCollab #PinoyBlushBlossom 

🌸 Blush Blossom Fan Fest Project

📊✨ BBFanFest Transparency Report: Chika Minute Edition ✨📊
Total na na-fundraise: ₱62,441.41
Mga bestie, grabe. Hindi lang ito fundraising — ito ay fan-ifestation. 🤌 Thank you so much sa lahat ng nag-donate, nag-share, nag-tiwala, at nag-cheer silently sa gilid. Kayo ang tunay na MVPs. 🫶

Time for receipts and real talk 🧾👇

🎶 Part 1 Highlights (aka: our big debut)
📦 ₱40,941.41 onhand | 💸 ₱48,876.03 spent (yes bestie, lumampas tayo pero wait lang)
📎 View full breakdown: https://t.co/BJnpQCIuRQ

✅ Fanbook Projects by PH ANYs – filled with feels, art, letters, and hugot from the fandom. Currently being prepped for pick-up soon, promise it’s happening, hindi ito ghosting! 👻📚

✅ Custom Vinyl Albums for Emi & Bonnie – like hello??? Vinyl with those Voice Chakra?? G na G?? These slayed the Thai GL Fan Fest booth also! Naka-feature sila like true main characters. 💿🫶

✅ 12 TukTuk Ads Around GMMTV – with @JustForYou0412 (collab na legit), and yes, on June 27, buong Bangkok will witness the EmiBonnie agenda. Sorry to the streets, they’re about to serve. 💨🚕💕

📉 Nag-exceed tayo by ₱7,934.62 – kasi quality over kuripot, you know? But don’t worry, Part 2 covered for ate girl. 🙏

💝 Part 2 Highlights: Pinoy Blush Blossom Project™
📥 ₱21,500 raised | 💸 ₱20,681.60 used
📎 View full breakdown: https://t.co/gjg1ltUaTc

This one’s all about vibes and gifts from Pinoy ANYs, kasi minsan love language talaga natin ay padala. 🎁💌

✅ Covered Part 1’s gastos – kasi sharing is caring. Tumulong si Part 2 kahit hindi siya obligated. Queen behavior. 👑

✅ All Surprise Gifts Delivered to Thailand! – like as in andun na sila. Hindi chika. Confirmed. Ready to meet their rightful owners a.k.a. E & B. ✈️🇹🇭

🎁 Gift #1 👠 – high-class, high-style
🎁 Gift #2 👜 – practical AND pa-cute
🎁 Gift #3 🥨🛍️ – snack bundle meets kilig bundle

📍 Remaining funds: ₱818.40 – naka-park lang for next project. Hindi yan nawawala. 💅

🌸 What Made It All Possible™
Honestly? Kayo. 🫵
Literal fan-powered effort. Walang brand deal, walang sponsor, just pure love and shared delulu. Yung ₱20, yung ₱200, yung retweet, yung “sige na nga” GCash transfer — it all added up to something beautiful. bawat centavo went into making something beautiful for Emi & Bonnie 🫶 This isn’t just a fandom, it’s a fanily. (Fan + Family, gets?) 🥹

📌 Leftover funds? G na G for next project. Tuloy-tuloy ang fangirling. Tuloy ang push. Tuloy ang pagmamahal. 💖
